evidence.quote: May I thank the Secretary of State for his statement, affording as it does an opportunity for the House to pay tribute not only to Nurse Cafferkey and all the other NHS volunteers, but the staff of the Royal Free hospital in my constituency
We have been very involved in international efforts to try to ensure that other countries, particularly in Europe, play their part as we in the UK have been doing.
I thank the Secretary of State for the tone and content of his statement.
We have learned the lessons to speed up the process so that people, I trust, will not have to wait as long.
